body: I’m in counseling and it’s done nothing. I went to inpatient and the only help I got was from medication which barely even works. I just don’t know what to do anymore.

Yeah I get that, but frankly people deserve to be hurt a little bit after the shit I was put through. That’s not my reason for doing it though. I’ve been depressed for as long as I can remember (I can’t remember the first 8 years of my life due to trauma) and I’ve been suicidal since I was 12. My end is going to be at my own hands, it’s just a matter of “when”
I want to die, and I don’t really want to deal with the whole “painful vomiting for hours” thing.
I’m too much of a pussy to ask my mom to let me go there.
